name: talent-alpha
description: A nightly or on-demand scan of layoff/WARN notices and funding-distress news that scores each signal against your open role and emails or renders one ranked card: who just became reachable, why now, your outreach hook and your edge. A fast scanner shortlists, then two independent judges (Advocate and Skeptic) argue each candidate, so no single model grades its own work. Ships as a standalone n8n workflow and as this Cowork/Claude Code plugin. Installs from onepromptman/talent-alpha.
